taxonomic_history.name: Platypus arisannensis
taxonomic_history.note: Original Murayama (1934:135) is supported by bibliographic sources but the printed species account has not been directly inspected. Beaver & Shih (2003) suggested a possible synonymy with Platypus lewisi; this is not adopted.
